Edit image 1, an exact native 1254 x 1254 crop of the approved daylight Daoist Q game map. Return exactly the same 1254 x 1254 framing, camera and scale. Image 2 is the whole-map layout context only; image 3 is stone/material reference; image 4 is the approved hand-painted Daoist Q style only. Do not add UI, people, night lighting or text.

Fix only the broken gray paving grout at approximately x220..380,y530..690 in the left-center of image 1. The descending diagonal grout currently stops abruptly at y626, while its lower piece starts far to the left. Redraw this short meeting area as continuous, clean diagonal stone boundaries or a deliberate T-junction, with every existing grout entering and exiting the repair area connected naturally. There must be no blind vertical cutoff, staggered offset, doubled edge, strange triangular wedge or melted crossing. Keep the existing broad rectangular stone slabs, natural gray/light cyan-gray stone, lighting and fine painterly texture.

Preserve ALL carved cream wall and stone ball finial in the lower-right half, all red paper scraps, existing leaf-shadow pattern, distant joints, and border pixels. This is a small local continuity repair, not a new floor layout. Do not sharpen into a black grid, add extra tiles, invent objects, change perspective, or blur the original. No text or watermark.
